palermo.name: Palermo Perfumes
palermo.note: Dupe house. Delivery worked out at checkout.

pcc.name: Perfume Clearance Centre
pcc.note: Online only; free delivery over $99, ships from Brisbane.

fnau.name: FragranceNet
fnau.note: Australian store (au.fragrancenet.com) priced in AUD; ships from Melbourne, or from the US with 5–7 extra days.

kmart.name: Kmart Marketplace
kmart.note: Third-party sellers on kmart.com.au; each seller sets its own delivery.

harveynorman.name: Harvey Norman
harveynorman.note: Online-only Customer Direct listings, shipped by an overseas supplier.

ozhb.name: Oz Hair & Beauty
ozhb.note: Some products ship free. The site blocks automated page reads, so checks rely on search snapshots.

strawberrynet.name: StrawberryNet
strawberrynet.note: Overseas; prices shown in AUD including GST.

priceline.name: Priceline
priceline.note: Free over $60 for Sister Club members (free to join).

bujairami.name: Bujairami
bujairami.note: Dupe house. Delivery from $10.20 for one bottle.

cw.name: Chemist Warehouse
cw.note: Free delivery over $70 on selected products; fee under that is approximate. Click & Collect is free.

dj.name: David Jones
dj.note: Some fragrances are click and collect only.

jmcg-mecca-50.note: Mecca showed an out-of-stock notice on one size.

meta.lastRunNote: Added 50 popular fragrances (25 men's, 25 unisex); the daily check is filling in their prices.
